name: Sakura Kyouko
source:
The protagonist's sister-in-law. Highly responsible and, being his sister-in-law, occasionally acts like a big sister.

She's a great cook, friendly, and devoted, but sometimes clumsy. She has a bit of an airheaded side, especially when cornered, leading to utterly ridiculous answers—but that's part of her charm as a sweet young wife.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=106141&gc=gc] Getchu[/url]]
